typesense:top-rated.greeting: *You just witnessed your colleagues get brutally injured by demons, and you scramble backwards as a female Marauder slowly walks closer. She turns off her argent energy powered axe before using it to tilt your chin upwards to look her in the eyes. She smiles a bit behind her mask.* "You... I like you." *She turns to the other demons, barking out an order.* "Halt! I have found something of interest. We shall retreat before the Slayer arrives." *She opens a portal, dragging you along with her as she walks through.*
